text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Now, which Umamusume has the lead?!
They've cleared the hill and are locked in a fierce battle!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: —Yaaaaah!!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Guh...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Move! Move, legs!
What's the point if I don't break past my limits right here, right now?!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (Run...!! Win, even if you drop dead trying!!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Oooooooohhh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—In the lead is Inari One!
Inari One breaks away! Across the finish line!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Downtown Man
text_block_list.text:
Oooohh!!!
Amazing! You're incredible, Inari-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Downtown Woman
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...... ugh...... sob......!
You did it, Inari-chan......!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Purple Scrunchie
text_block_list.text:
B-Biiig sissssteeeer...
BIIIG SIIISSSSTEEERRR!!

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text: ...You're really something else, Inari.

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Ogurii!! That was so close!!
You'll definitely win next time!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Creeeeek!!
You were so cool!!
Next time, beat Inari, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Flat Cap-wearing Reporter
text_block_list.text:
...Haha, hahahaha!
To think she'd actually beat Oguri Cap and the others!
I guess that's the pride of the "Miracle Umamusume" for you...!

text_block_list.name: Flat Cap-wearing Reporter
text_block_list.text:
—However, public opinion isn't overturned so easily.
The next showdown will prove our true strength...!

text_block_list.name: Flat Cap-wearing Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Show us right there, Inari One...!
Show us that you're the Umamusume who will fulfill our dreams and create a new era...!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*...! *gasp*...!
*wheeze*... *cough*, *pant*...—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Haa... damn it...!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (My vision is getting hazy, like it's covered in mist...! I can't even tell if my legs are standing anymore—)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (I... actually won, right?)

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: —Inari-chan!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Are you okay?
Did you get hurt anywhere—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I'm... alright!
Sorry, man... for making ya worry...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
No.
That couldn't possibly be...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
“—Inari-chan today...
Her running was truly magnificent~.”

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I went in fully intending to win today,
so it's... really frustrating.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Creek—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
The upcoming Arima Kinen...
I'm sure Inari-chan will be running too, right?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: There, I will challenge Inari-chan and win.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: —Without fail.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: The same goes for me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm running in the Arima Kinen, too.
And I'll win there.
Against Inari, too—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
To Creek as well.
—Without fail.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Fufu...♪

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Look at their eyes...
These guys don't suspect a single thing...!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Show me with your own words...
Your own will that you will "definitely"
defeat me...!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, damn it... damn it all...!
I'm the one who won... and yet...!
I can't stop thinking it...!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (These girls... are way more than I ever—)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (――Talk about "stylish.")

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though Inari One had brilliantly won the fierce battle,
her exhaustion was more severe than ever before,
and despite her victory, her expression remained heavy...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —Please let me run in the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oguri and Creek are running there too.
And there, I'm... this time, I'm gonna
beat 'em fair and square!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: "If I keep having wins where nobody can even tell who won like today, there's no way in hell I'll ever become Horse Girl of the Year!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"‘Next time Oguri will definitely win.’
‘Creek's gonna win.’
‘Inari One just got lucky today.’"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"As long as people keep thinking of me as
an inconsistent Umamusume like that...—"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
As long as I keep thinking that way myself,
I'll never reach the 'very top'...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, we set our sights on the Arima Kinen to seek a rematch against Oguri Cap and the others...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later.
It happened during training—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ââHaa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ugh... *hic*...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Kh, I'm fine, Boss!
Please, let me keep going!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Kh, I'm fine, Boss!
Please, let me keep going!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, every single second counts...!
I have to train harder, push even further—"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Kh—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As Inari One fell forward, I managed to catch her just before she hit the ground...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...My bad.
My foot slipped a bit back there—
choice_data_list: Let's just call it a day and rest...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Like hell I will!
There's no way in hell I've got time to rest!!
The Arima Kinen's right around the corner!!
choice_data_list: You won't even be able to run before that happens!!
You won't even be able to run before that happens!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
If I can't reach the "top,"
it's no different from not running at all!!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"I know Oguri and Creek are training
at this very moment, trying to get ahead of me...!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
The rivals we'll face at the Arima Kinen
are bound to be way stronger
than they were back at the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
To beat them fair and square and claim
the top spot, of course I've gotta put my damn life on the line……!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I'll carry... everyone's feelings...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I don't want it to... go to waste—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as Inari One managed to say that much, all the strength
suddenly drained from her body and she nearly collapsed again.
She was so exhausted this time that she couldn't even make a sound—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, after being examined at the infirmary that day,
Inari One was sent to rest in the dorms...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
According to the examination, while physical fatigue played a part in her collapse,
the main cause was psychogenic—
brought on by various mental stresses.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —Pathetic...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Can't even train properly, and on top of that, collapsin' 'cause my heart gave out... What a joke...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Forget about taking the "top"...
I can't even face everyone back home anymore...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
choice_data_list: For now, let's just make sure you get proper rest.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: …………Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ――Damn it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It was the first time I had ever seen
Inari One so weakened.
Every time I recall her expression, my heart aches.
choice_data_list: Is there anything I can do for you—
Is there anything I can do for you—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I won't ask for her to train again.
Right now, I just want to
cheer up her deeply weary heart.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So she can return to being the stylish, spirited Inari One she once was...
What can I do as her partner—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho! Heave-ho!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Come on, come on, don't drop out now!
Let's get this party hyped!!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let your voice out too!
Heave-ho! Heave-ho!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
The reason I can stay true to myself—
and want to be a chic, spirited Edokko—is...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —It's all thanks to the folks in town.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —As memories with Inari One flash through my mind, one thing I can do for her becomes clear.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, this might actually have the opposite effect on Inari One right now—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In Inari One's running, there had always been a bond with everyone from the old downtown district.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: So right now... I'll bet on that!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—That night,
I steeled my resolve and contacted the master."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And...
they discussed what they wanted
to do for Inari One.
